translation: If one cannot precisely study the sources of disease and deeply explore the discourses on formulas, then even if a hundred physicians guard the illness and many drugs gather at the gate, it only adds much doubt and cannot cure it even once. The sovereign honors the worthy and values the Way, nourishes longevity and prays for years, so several gentlemen such as Zhang, Wang, and Li successively entered, all admiring the style and requesting benefit, honoring and following it. Therefore the Hongbao (Great Treasure), the Jinkui (Golden Coffer), the Qingnang (Blue Bag), and the Lüzhi (Green Book) are often present; from this one knows that what the sun and moon illuminate is far, and what the sages move is deep. As for sparing the spirit and nourishing harmony, resting the old and supplementing the ill, one can hear and see them. I dare to gather and record them; then what was not present in antiquity, now I compile and arrange together, and the task is complete.
